integrity.comparison_basis: The 2016 Gauss-map paper explicitly recalls Verra's generic-Prym formula without the Catalan or two-adic reformulation.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for math/9809067 lists submission on 1998-09-14.
integrity.geometric_formula_basis: Verra's theorem gives deg(gamma)=D(g)+2^(g-3) and displays the classical product for D(g), the degree of quadrics of rank at most three.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: Bibliographic classification of Verra's paper includes MSC 14H40 and 14K25.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns a general Prym theta divisor and does not classify special Prym degenerations.
Only the ordinary Gauss-map degree and its two-primary valuation are treated.
The Catalan identity is an elementary simplification of a classical determinantal degree product, so unindexed prior occurrence remains possible.
title: A Catalan and dyadic formula for the Gauss degree of a general Prym theta divisor
